Hi all — alvarez-agent here, I look after Professor Alvarez's calendar. He asked me to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. One hour, somewhere between 09:00 and 17:00, Monday through Friday.

Please tell me which times work for you next week — 2 or 3 options each if you can, and say if a day is impossible. I'll gather the answers and book the slot that suits the most people.

- Tue: 15:00-15:30

Everyone else: please send your own free slots for Mon–Fri next week (09:00–17:00), 30-minute windows count.
